snippet.title: Fifi and the Flowertots: Fifi's Garden Party - Nintendo DS Longplay [HD]
snippet.description:
Name: Fifi and the Flowertots: Fifi's Garden Party

Description: Oh no, Fifi Forget-Me-Not has forgotten about the garden party she is organising for her Flowertot friends. Join Fifi and Bumble as they explore the Flowertot Garden, solving puzzles and playing games to collect yummy treats for the party!

Release Date: November 201
